compliance.controlled_movement_rule_vers.reason: Exact reviewed official rule releases require the isolated regulatory importer.

compliance.controlled_substance_entries:.reason: The license vocabulary does not represent all NDPS/controlled-substance authorities or effective applicability rules, so counterparty authorization cannot be proved for every controlled batch.

compliance.destructions:destructions_cro.reason: The approval record stores no approved batch/quantity snapshot, so posted destruction lines cannot be compared with the authorization.

compliance.recall_batches:recall_batches.reason: Recall-tagged inventory documents are typed, but exact exposure snapshots and posted-ledger action totals require the reviewed compliance command boundary.

compliance.storage_rule_versions:storage.reason: Effective non-overlap and evidence-bound activation require the compliance command boundary.

compliance.temperature_readings:temperat.reason: A reading without batch_id has no product/storage-rule reference, and no effective-dated location storage rule exists; permitted range resolution cannot be proved for every row.

finance.accounting_events:accounting_eve.reason: Several typed sources remain mutable until their reviewed posting/reversal commands exist, so a trigger could verify current posted status but could not prove the source is immutable after event insertion.

finance.adjustment_note_lines:adjustment.reason: The canonical Decimal calculator is application code; no reviewed SQL calculator or posting command persists proof that the exact ruleset was executed.

finance.adjustment_notes:adjustment_note.reason: No reviewed posting/reversal command atomically invokes the Decimal authority and creates the tax document, journal, accounting event, and bounded compensating note.

finance.bank_statement_lines:bank_statem.reason: The schema has no verified-import command or transaction marker proving that every line was inserted by the same authenticated parser transaction.

finance.expense_claim_lines:expense_clai.reason: The schema has no effective-dated evidence policy identifying which expense lines require receipts.

finance.expense_claims:expense_claims_cr.reason: The schema has no reviewed approver authorization predicate or account-mapping command for atomic journal creation.

finance.payments:payments_cross_row_guar.reason: No reviewed payment posting/reversal command supplies ledger account mappings and atomically creates the journal, event, and allocation reversals.

tax.documents:documents_cross_row_guard.reason: There is no reviewed tax-document posting command that binds source line snapshots, registration context, cumulative adjustments, and the canonical Decimal result atomically.

tax.einvoice_rule_versions:einvoice_rule.reason: Exact reviewed official rule releases require the isolated regulatory importer.

tax.einvoices:einvoices_cross_row_guard.reason: PostgreSQL cryptographic byte hashing is not provisioned by the canonical platform contract, and no provider-command boundary exists to prove exact request/response/QR envelopes and append-only cancellation evidence.

tax.eway_bills:eway_bills_cross_row_guar.reason: PostgreSQL cryptographic byte hashing is not provisioned by the canonical platform contract, and no provider-command boundary exists to prove exact request/response envelopes and append-only cancellation evidence.

tax.gst_adjustment_rule_versions:gst_adj.reason: Exact reviewed official rule releases require the isolated regulatory importer.

tax.organization_fiscal_tax_facts:organi.reason: A reviewed verification command is required to bind immutable turnover, TAN and notified-deductor facts to verified evidence.

tax.portal_document_lines:portal_documen.reason: The schema has no parser command or transaction marker proving every line is inserted exactly once inside the parent parse transaction.

tax.portal_documents:portal_documents_cr.reason: Attachment equality and terminal immutability are enforceable, but no parser command can prove all parsed lines were inserted atomically before publishing the terminal state.

tax.reconciliation_items:reconciliation_.reason: The schema has no reviewed resolution authorization predicate or canonical audit-event command binding a one-time resolution.

tax.reconciliation_runs:reconciliation_r.reason: A row trigger cannot prove repeatable-read isolation, complete population coverage, or one atomic reconciliation algorithm execution without a reviewed stored command.

tax.registration_branches:registration_b.reason: Effective branch associations and immutable statutory use require a reviewed registration command and posting lookup.

tax.return_documents:return_documents_cr.reason: Return-type eligibility is a versioned statutory rule but no effective-dated eligibility ruleset is stored; inventing a timeless mapping would be unsafe.

tax.tax_code_versions:tax_code_versions_.reason: A row constraint cannot verify official source and canonical dataset artifacts, typed review, exact-set insertion, or atomic whole-release supersession; the isolated regulatory import command owns this authority.

tax.withholding_basis_lines:withholding_.reason: Exact source basis and cumulative threshold rows must be inserted atomically by the withholding deduction command.

tax.withholding_certificate_lines:withho.reason: Certificate M:N coverage requires exact statement-line, party, regime, period and amount verification.

tax.withholding_certificates:withholding.reason: A reviewed certificate importer must verify and retain one immutable per-deductee authority artifact and correction lineage.

tax.withholding_deposit_lines:withholdin.reason: Deposit allocation components and cumulative deduction residuals require one locked deposit command.

tax.withholding_deposits:withholding_dep.reason: A reviewed command must bind one exact posted government payment and verified challan to immutable deduction allocations and compensating reversal.

tax.withholding_rule_versions:withholdin.reason: The typed rule table exists, but the regulated importer does not yet parse and atomically activate exact withholding_rules releases.

tax.withholding_statement_lines:withhold.reason: Statement membership and deposit coverage require locked authority verification.

tax.withholding_statements:withholding_s.reason: A reviewed filing command must freeze one exact statement population, acknowledgement and append-only revision lineage.

tax.withholdings:withholdings_cross_row_.reason: The typed rule and basis model exists, but no reviewed command yet proves exact imported-rule selection, earlier-event timing, cumulative threshold basis, journal/allocation creation, and corrective reversal.
